description: List and search Data Security Settings from OneUptime with optional filtering, pagination, and sorting. Returns an array of Data Security Setting objects plus the total matching count.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 10, Maximum: 100.

query.description: Filter criteria for Data Security Settings. Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.

select.description: Optional: field names to return for each Data Security Setting (e.g. ["_id", "name"]). Omit to get all readable fields. Large fields excluded by default (request explicitly if needed): allowedValues, disabledDataTypeIds.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination. Default: 0. Example: skip=10 to start from the 11th record.

sort.description: Sort order for results. Use "ASC" for ascending or "DESC" for descending. Example: {"createdAt": "DESC"} to sort by newest first.
